title: Multimodal Tooling for LLMs
summary: This module provides core functionalities for processing and encoding multimodal data, specifically images and audio, for use with Large Language Models. It includes image preprocessing, audio feature extraction, and integration with GGUF models.

nodes.label: Convert GGUF Key-Value to String
nodes.title: GGUF Key-Value to String
nodes.description: Converts a GGUF key-value pair from a GGUF context into its string representation, handling various data types including arrays and nested structures for display or serialization.

nodes.label: Map Projector Type String
nodes.title: Map Projector Type String
nodes.description: Maps a string identifier to its corresponding internal projector type enum, used for configuring image processing pipelines based on model architecture.

nodes.label: Encode Float Image Data
nodes.title: Encode Float Image Data
nodes.description: Encodes a raw float-based image buffer (height, width, 3 channels) into a feature vector using the configured CLIP model, preparing it for multimodal LLM input.

nodes.label: Debug Image Encoding
nodes.title: Debug Image Encoding
nodes.description: A debugging utility that encodes a synthetic image filled with a specified value, allowing for testing and inspection of the image encoding pipeline without real image data.

nodes.label: Preprocess Raw Image
nodes.title: Preprocess Raw Image
nodes.description: Preprocesses a raw 8-bit unsigned integer image (RGB) into a batch of normalized float images, applying resizing, padding, and slicing strategies based on the specific projector type (e.g., MiniCPM-V, Qwen, LLaVA).

nodes.label: Add Mel Spectrogram to Batch
nodes.title: Add Mel Spectrogram to Batch
nodes.description: Adds a mel spectrogram, represented as a float array with specified dimensions (n_mel, n_frames), to a batch of float images, treating it as an audio input for multimodal processing.

nodes.label: Convert Float Image to U8
nodes.title: Convert Float Image to U8
nodes.description: Converts a float-based image representation back into an 8-bit unsigned integer RGB format, scaling and clamping pixel values for display or saving.

nodes.label: Initialize CLIP Contexts
nodes.title: Initialize CLIP Contexts
nodes.description: Initializes the CLIP context for both vision and audio modalities by loading model parameters and tensors from a GGUF file, optionally performing a warmup run for performance.

nodes.label: Build Image from Pixels
nodes.title: Build Image from Pixels
nodes.description: Constructs an 8-bit unsigned integer image structure from raw RGB pixel data, specifying its width and height, making it ready for further image processing operations.

nodes.label: Calculate Embedding Size
nodes.title: Calculate Embedding Size
nodes.description: Calculates the expected byte size of the embedding output for a given CLIP context, typically based on the model's image size parameters.

nodes.label: Write Image to PPM
nodes.title: Write Image to PPM
nodes.description: Writes an 8-bit unsigned integer image to a PPM (Portable Pixmap) file, a simple image format often used for debugging or basic image output.

nodes.label: Save Image to BMP
nodes.title: Save Image to BMP
nodes.description: Saves an 8-bit unsigned integer image to a BMP (Bitmap) file, including handling file headers, info headers, and pixel data with appropriate padding and BGR conversion.

nodes.label: Get Batch Image Count
nodes.title: Get Batch Image Count
nodes.description: Returns the total number of individual images or audio spectrograms contained within a batch of float-based multimodal inputs.

nodes.label: Get Batch Image Width
nodes.title: Get Batch Image Width
nodes.description: Retrieves the width (or number of frames for audio) of a specific image or spectrogram entry within a float-based multimodal input batch, given its index.

nodes.label: Get Batch Image Height
nodes.title: Get Batch Image Height
nodes.description: Retrieves the height (or number of mel bins for audio) of a specific image or spectrogram entry within a float-based multimodal input batch, given its index.

nodes.label: Compute Log Mel Spectrogram
nodes.title: Compute Log Mel Spectrogram
nodes.description: Computes the log mel spectrogram from raw audio samples, applying windowing, padding, pre-emphasis, and normalization to extract frequency-domain features suitable for audio models.

nodes.label: Evaluate Multimodal Chunks
nodes.title: Evaluate Multimodal Chunks
nodes.description: Orchestrates the evaluation of a sequence of multimodal input chunks (text, image, audio) by an LLM, managing the context and updating the 'n_past' position for subsequent evaluations.

nodes.label: Encode Multimodal Chunk
nodes.title: Encode Multimodal Chunk
nodes.description: Encodes a single multimodal input chunk, dispatching to the appropriate vision or audio encoding function based on the chunk's type (image or audio), or skipping for text chunks.

nodes.label: Get Chunk Token Count
nodes.title: Get Chunk Token Count
nodes.description: Determines the number of tokens associated with a given multimodal input chunk, whether it's a text sequence, an encoded image, or an audio spectrogram.

nodes.label: Get Chunk Position Count
nodes.title: Get Chunk Position Count
nodes.description: Retrieves the number of positions (similar to tokens) that a multimodal input chunk will occupy in the LLM's context, accounting for different modalities.

nodes.label: Get Bitmap Byte Size
nodes.title: Get Bitmap Byte Size
nodes.description: Returns the total byte size of a multimodal bitmap object, providing information about its memory footprint.

groups.label: Image Preprocessing
groups.title: Image Preprocessing
groups.description: Handles the conversion, resizing, normalization, and slicing of raw image data into a format suitable for multimodal models, supporting various projector types.

groups.label: Audio Feature Extraction
groups.title: Audio Feature Extraction
groups.description: Processes raw audio samples to derive mel spectrograms, which are frequency-domain representations used as input for audio-aware multimodal models.

groups.label: Multimodal Data Handling
groups.title: Multimodal Data Handling
groups.description: Manages the encoding and evaluation of diverse input chunks (text, image, audio) for integration with large language models, abstracting modality-specific processing.

groups.label: CLIP Context Management
groups.title: CLIP Context Management
groups.description: Provides functions for initializing and managing the CLIP model's vision and audio contexts, including loading model parameters and calculating embedding sizes.

groups.label: Image Output & Batch Utilities
groups.title: Image Output & Batch Utilities
groups.description: Offers utilities for saving processed images to standard formats (PPM, BMP) and for querying properties of batched float-based image/audio data.

groups.label: GGUF & General Utilities
groups.title: GGUF & General Utilities
groups.description: Contains general utility functions, including GGUF metadata conversion to string and basic byte size calculation for internal data structures.
